title: Loading functions by name
description:
Fill a table of function pointers from a "module", with fallbacks for missing ones.

```
found add, multiply
missing fastSqrt: using the slow fallback
all 3 entries filled; calling: add 5, multiply 6, fastSqrt 3
```
hints: `api.add = reinterpret_cast<int (*)(int, int)>(getProc(m, "add"));` is what the cast after `GetProcAddress` looks like (lesson 2.03).
A small table of `{name, address of the field, required, fallback}` saves writing each one by hand.
requirements: A fake module is a `std::map<std::string, void*>`; `getProc(module, name)` returns `nullptr` when absent.
A `struct Api { int (*add)(int, int); ... }` filled by casting the results to the right types.
A required function that is missing makes the load fail; an optional one gets a fallback.
stretch: Write a template `load<F>(module, name)` that returns `F*`.
